description: Fuels Treatment Effectiveness Reporting Dashboard is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CAL FIRE. The Fuels Treatment Effectiveness Reports (FTER) evaluate the impacts vegetation management treatments have on fire behavior and highlight how fuel reduction activities assist in suppression efforts and protect life, property, and the natural resources of California. This web experience contains two dashboards intended to display the effects of involved treatments. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher CAL FIRE. Its tags are CAL FIRE, Fire and Fuels, Fuels Treatment Effectiveness Reporting, cal fire. It offers 2 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
